title: Note page
summary: A static informational page: a heading and a block of prose in a card. No data, no callbacks - the page-type building block for a one-off About/Overview/Summary page. Static slotted mode (for server-rendered, JavaScript-optional sites): write your own markup as the page's children with no config and it renders in the default slot as written, never created, moved or changed by the element; without JavaScript the author's text is all there.

props.name: config
props.description: { heading, body, cardHeading }. heading is the page's h1 text, body is the card's prose, cardHeading is an optional card title (the card has no header without it).

slots.description: Static slotted mode only: your own markup (a heading, a pk-card, prose), shown as written. Decided at connect: child elements (other than slot=title) and an empty config.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Wraps the built pk-stack > pk-heading + pk-card content.

a11y: The heading is a real pk-heading (h1); the card's body is a plain paragraph.

examples.title: About page (set config from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP, so wire it the way pk-tool-page's run is wired)
Static slotted mode (plain markup, no script, nothing built)
examples.html: Written as plain markup: with JavaScript blocked the text is still all there.
